members.snippet:

このほか…

members.snippet: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres has paid tribute to Qatar’s late Father Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani.

events.headline: Pro-Palestinian protesters oppose Israel embassy opening in Slovenia

members.title: Pro-Palestinian protesters oppose Israel embassy opening in Slovenia
members.snippet: Pro-Palestinian protesters gathered in Slovenia’s capital to oppose the opening of Israel’s first resident embassy.
